method: manual trajectory review + source/schema-reference checks; not exhaustive, not performance validation

candidates.title: 出版年份正则提取
candidates.prepare: 为 books_info 保留 book_id、details，并逐行计算 substring(details from 'on [A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, (\d{4})') 为 pub_year_text。
candidates.uses: Q4 从派生列计算非空数量；Q5 用派生列 IS NULL 筛选原始记录。
candidates.constraints: 不是缓存 Q4 的计数结果来回答 Q5；需保存行级派生列，保留 NULL 和原始文本语义。只有两次使用。
candidates.evidence: 两条 SQL 对同一 details 列使用完全相同的正则提取；无 WHERE 限制输入。

consumers.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  COUNT(substring(details from 'on [A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, (\d{4})')) AS with_year
FROM books_info;

SELECT book_id, details FROM books_info
WHERE substring(details from 'on [A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, (\d{4})') IS NULL;

candidates.title: 文学类别筛选与布尔标记
candidates.prepare: 对 books_info 计算 categories LIKE '%Literature & Fiction%' 标记，准备满足条件的完整行子集，保留 book_id/title/author/rating_number/details/categories。
candidates.uses: Q5/Q7/Q8 使用类别子集，保留各自 LIMIT、英语条件及投影；Q6 的 lit_fic 与 lit_fic_english 使用该子集，total 仍需全表总数。
candidates.constraints: Q6 仅部分计算受益；Q5 样本结果本身不够；NOT ILIKE 的 NULL 语义必须保留。预备完整子集可能比首次 LIMIT 查询贵。
candidates.evidence: 四次调用都出现完全相同的类别 LIKE 条件，包括 Q6 的 FILTER 子表达式。

consumers.sql: SELECT book_id, title, categories, details FROM books_info WHERE categories LIKE '%Literature & Fiction%' LIMIT 5

SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE categories LIKE '%Literature & Fiction%') AS lit_fic, count(*) FILTER (WHERE categories LIKE '%Literature & Fiction%' AND details ILIKE '%english%') AS lit_fic_english FROM books_info
SELECT details FROM books_info WHERE categories LIKE '%Literature & Fiction%' AND details NOT ILIKE '%english%' LIMIT 10
SELECT book_id, title, author, rating_number, details FROM books_info WHERE categories LIKE '%Literature & Fiction%'

candidates.title: 评论表的一次扫描统计准备

candidates.evidence: 三条都是 review 上无 WHERE 的完整输入统计，Q5/Q8 共同需要 purchase_id；Q5/Q6 重复全表 COUNT。

candidates.title: Owner Assignment 历史子集
candidates.prepare: 准备 casehistory__c WHERE field__c='Owner Assignment'，保留 id/caseid__c/createddate/oldvalue__c/newvalue__c 的完整重复行。
candidates.uses: Q4/Q7 在此基础上继续连接 Case；Q5/Q6/Q10 的 CTE 从子集读取后保留各自窗口、分组与 Join；Q8 继续过滤 oldvalue。
candidates.constraints: 日期窗口不同，不能复用某一个窗口的聚合结果；这里共享不带日期约束的共同输入。保留 < 与 <= 差异和重复行。
candidates.evidence: 六次调用均显式包含同表同值的 field__c 等值筛选，包括 CTE 中的筛选。

consumers.sql:
SELECT h.caseid__c, h.createddate, h.oldvalue__c, h.newvalue__c,
       c.ownerid AS current_ownerid, c.createddate AS case_createddate
FROM casehistory__c h
JOIN "Case" c ON c.id = h.caseid__c
WHERE h.field__c = 'Owner Assignment'
  AND h.createddate >= '2022-04-10'
  AND h.createddate <= '2023-04-10'
ORDER BY h.caseid__c, h.createddate, h.id;

WITH owner_assignments AS (
  SELECT caseid__c, createddate, oldvalue__c, newvalue__c
  FROM casehistory__c
  WHERE field__c = 'Owner Assignment'
    AND createddate >= '2022-04-01'
    AND createddate < '2023-04-01'
), handled AS (
  SELECT newvalue__c AS agent_id, COUNT(DISTINCT caseid__c) AS handled_cases
  FROM owner_assignments
  WHERE newvalue__c IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY newvalue__c
), transfers AS (
  SELECT oldvalue__c AS agent_id, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count
  FROM owner_assignments
  WHERE oldvalue__c IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oldvalue__c
)
SELECT h.agent_id, h.handled_cases, COALESCE(t.transfer_count, 0) AS transfer_count
FROM handled h
LEFT JOIN transfers t ON t.agent_id = h.agent_id
ORDER BY transfer_count ASC, handled_cases ASC, agent_id ASC;

WITH a AS (
  SELECT caseid__c, createddate, oldvalue__c, newvalue__c,
         SUBSTR(createddate, 1, 4) AS yr,
         CAST(SUBSTR(createddate, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS mo
  FROM casehistory__c
  WHERE field__c = 'Owner Assignment'
), q AS (
  SELECT *, yr || '-Q' || CAST(((mo - 1) / 3 + 1) AS TEXT) AS quarter FROM a
), handled AS (
  SELECT newvalue__c agent_id, COUNT(DISTINCT caseid__c) handled_cases_all
  FROM a WHERE newvalue__c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY newvalue__c
), transfers AS (
  SELECT oldvalue__c agent_id, COUNT(*) transfer_count_all
  FROM a WHERE oldvalue__c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY oldvalue__c
), quarter_transfers AS (
  SELECT quarter, oldvalue__c agent_id, COUNT(*) transfers
  FROM q WHERE oldvalue__c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY quarter, oldvalue__c
)
SELECT h.agent_id, h.handled_cases_all, COALESCE(t.transfer_count_all, 0) transfer_count_all,
       COALESCE(STRING_AGG(qt.quarter || ':' || qt.transfers, ', ' ORDER BY qt.quarter), '') AS transfers_by_quarter
FROM handled h
LEFT JOIN transfers t ON t.agent_id=h.agent_id
LEFT JOIN quarter_transfers qt ON qt.agent_id=h.agent_id
GROUP BY h.agent_id, h.handled_cases_all, t.transfer_count_all
ORDER BY transfer_count_all DESC, agent_id;

SELECT h.caseid__c, h.createddate, h.oldvalue__c AS from_agent, h.newvalue__c AS to_agent,
       c.createddate AS case_createddate
FROM casehistory__c h
JOIN "Case" c ON c.id=h.caseid__c
WHERE h.field__c='Owner Assignment'
  AND h.oldvalue__c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY h.createddate, h.caseid__c;

SELECT caseid__c, createddate, oldvalue__c AS from_agent, newvalue__c AS to_agent
FROM casehistory__c
WHERE field__c='Owner Assignment'
  AND oldvalue__c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY createddate, caseid__c;

WITH period_owner_assignments AS (
  SELECT caseid__c, createddate, oldvalue__c, newvalue__c
  FROM casehistory__c
  WHERE field__c = 'Owner Assignment'
    AND createddate >= '2022-04-10'
    AND createddate <= '2023-04-10'
), transferred_cases AS (
  SELECT caseid__c
  FROM period_owner_assignments
  GROUP BY caseid__c
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
), handling_agents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.newvalue__c AS agent_id
  FROM period_owner_assignments p
  JOIN transferred_cases t ON t.caseid__c = p.caseid__c
  WHERE p.newvalue__c IS NOT NULL
), transfer_counts AS (
  SELECT oldvalue__c AS agent_id, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count
  FROM period_owner_assignments
  WHERE oldvalue__c IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oldvalue__c
)
SELECT a.agent_id, COALESCE(t.transfer_count, 0) AS transfer_count
FROM handling_agents a
LEFT JOIN transfer_counts t ON t.agent_id = a.agent_id
ORDER BY transfer_count ASC, a.agent_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

candidates.title: 原始 ID 的 Opportunity–Contract 公共 Join
candidates.prepare: 准备 Opportunity o INNER JOIN Contract c ON o.ContractID__c=c.Id 的行级结果，保留 o.Id/OwnerId/CreatedDate/CloseDate/ContractID__c 和 c.Id/CompanySignedDate。
candidates.uses: Q3/Q4/Q5/Q10 在公共 Join 上保留各自日期条件与聚合/投影；Q8 仅 apr_close_with_contract 子查询可使用它。
candidates.constraints: Q8 其他两个独立表统计不能用此 Join 代替；须保留 Join 多重性。全量 Join 可能比各查询谓词下推更贵；本任务未通过答案验证。
candidates.evidence: 五次调用的相关分支均是相同两表、相同原始等值键的 INNER JOIN。

consumers.sql: SELECT o.OwnerId, AVG(date_diff('day', CAST(substr(o.CreatedDate,1,10) AS DATE), CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE))) AS avg_days, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Opportunity o JOIN Contract c ON o.ContractID__c = c.Id WHERE CAST(substr(o.CreatedDate,1,10) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2023-04-01' AND DATE '2023-04-30' AND c.CompanySignedDate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.OwnerId ORDER BY avg_days ASC

SELECT o.OwnerId, AVG(date_diff('day', CAST(substr(o.CreatedDate,1,10) AS DATE), CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE))) AS avg_days, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Opportunity o JOIN Contract c ON o.ContractID__c = c.Id WHERE CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2023-04-01' AND DATE '2023-04-30' GROUP BY o.OwnerId ORDER BY avg_days ASC

SELECT o.OwnerId, AVG(date_diff('day', CAST(substr(o.CreatedDate,1,10) AS DATE), CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE))) AS avg_days, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Opportunity o JOIN Contract c ON o.ContractID__c = c.Id WHERE CAST(o.CloseDate AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2023-04-01' AND DATE '2023-04-30' AND c.CompanySignedDate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.OwnerId ORDER BY avg_days ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Opportunity WHERE CloseDate BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-04-30') AS apr_close, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Opportunity o JOIN Contract c ON o.ContractID__c=c.Id WHERE o.CloseDate BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-04-30' AND c.CompanySignedDate IS NOT NULL) AS apr_close_with_contract, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Contract WHERE CompanySignedDate BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-04-30') AS apr_signed

SELECT o.Id, o.OwnerId, substr(o.CreatedDate,1,10) AS created, o.CloseDate, o.ContractID__c, c.CompanySignedDate FROM Opportunity o JOIN Contract c ON o.ContractID__c = c.Id WHERE substr(o.CreatedDate,1,10) BETWEEN '2023-04-01' AND '2023-04-30' AND c.CompanySignedDate IS NOT NULL

candidates.title: 同一订单窗口及订单明细 Join
candidates.prepare: 先准备 Order.EffectiveDate 在 '2022-06-25' 至 '2022-11-25'（含端点）的订单子集；另准备该子集与 OrderItem 的 OrderItem.OrderId=Order.Id Join，保留明细及原始 OwnerId，可派生 Quantity*UnitPrice。
candidates.uses: Q13 用订单子集；Q11/Q14 用明细 Join 分别按原始 OwnerId、去 # 后 OwnerId 聚合。
candidates.constraints: 这是一个两层准备方案，筛选和 Join 不重复算两次机会。Q13 不能从明细 Join 去重恢复订单（可能有无明细订单）。失败 Q9 不计入；不直接复用不同分组的 SUM。
candidates.evidence: Q11/Q13/Q14 使用相同闭区间；Q11/Q14 使用相同 INNER JOIN 与行金额表达式。

consumers.sql: SELECT o.OwnerId, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS n_orders FROM "Order" o JOIN OrderItem oi ON oi.OrderId = o.Id WHERE o.EffectiveDate >= '2022-06-25' AND o.EffectiveDate <= '2022-11-25' GROUP BY o.OwnerId ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, AccountId, OwnerId, EffectiveDate FROM "Order" WHERE EffectiveDate >= '2022-06-25' AND EffectiveDate <= '2022-11-25'

SELECT REPLACE(o.OwnerId,'#','') AS owner, ROUND(SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice),2) AS total_sales FROM "Order" o JOIN OrderItem oi ON oi.OrderId = o.Id WHERE o.EffectiveDate >= '2022-06-25' AND o.EffectiveDate <= '2022-11-25' GROUP BY REPLACE(o.OwnerId,'#','') ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5

candidates.title: 商机的全表与账户维度统计准备
candidates.prepare: 一次扫描 AccountId/ContractID__c/OwnerId，分别维护全局精确 distinct 状态和按 AccountId 的计数、distinct ContractID 状态。
candidates.uses: 供应 Q6 的全局统计和 Q10 的账户分组统计。
candidates.constraints: 弱候选：共享扫描与部分状态准备；不能将每账户 distinct 计数直接相加得到全局 distinct，必须单独维护并处理 NULL。
candidates.evidence: 两条都完整读取 Opportunity 的 AccountId/ContractID__c，无 WHERE；分组层次不同。

consumers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_opp, COUNT(DISTINCT AccountId) AS accts, COUNT(DISTINCT ContractID__c) AS contracts, COUNT(DISTINCT OwnerId) AS owners FROM Opportunity
SELECT o.AccountId, COUNT(*) AS n_opp, COUNT(DISTINCT o.ContractID__c) AS n_con FROM Opportunity o GROUP BY o.AccountId ORDER BY n_opp DESC LIMIT 5

candidates.title: Owner Assignment 历史子集
candidates.prepare: 准备 field__c='Owner Assignment' 的完整行子集，保留 caseid__c/createddate/oldvalue__c/newvalue__c。
candidates.uses: Q3/Q6 施加同一日期窗口；Q4 单独施加 oldvalue 非空；保留不同排序和聚合。
candidates.constraints: 不能直接把 Q3 的有界结果供给不限日期的 Q4；共同准备必须覆盖三者。
candidates.evidence: 三条调用的直接查询或 CTE 均有同表同值 field__c 等值条件。

consumers.sql:
SELECT caseid__c, oldvalue__c, newvalue__c, createddate
FROM casehistory__c
WHERE field__c = 'Owner Assignment'
  AND createddate >= '2022-04-10'
  AND createddate < '2023-04-10'
ORDER BY caseid__c, createddate;

SELECT caseid__c, oldvalue__c, newvalue__c, createddate
FROM casehistory__c
WHERE field__c = 'Owner Assignment' AND oldvalue__c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY createddate;

WITH w AS (
  SELECT caseid__c, oldvalue__c, newvalue__c, createddate
  FROM casehistory__c
  WHERE field__c = 'Owner Assignment'
    AND createddate >= '2022-04-10' AND createddate < '2023-04-10'
),
handled AS (
  SELECT newvalue__c AS agent, COUNT(DISTINCT caseid__c) AS cases_handled
  FROM w GROUP BY newvalue__c
),
transfers AS (
  SELECT oldvalue__c AS agent, COUNT(*) AS transfer_count
  FROM w WHERE oldvalue__c IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oldvalue__c
)
SELECT t.agent, t.transfer_count, h.cases_handled
FROM transfers t
JOIN handled h ON h.agent = t.agent
WHERE h.cases_handled > 0
ORDER BY t.transfer_count ASC
LIMIT 5;

candidates.title: 原始 ID 的 Opportunity–Contract Join
candidates.prepare: 准备原始 ContractID__c=Id 的 INNER JOIN 明细，保留 OwnerId、机会原始日期、合同签署日期和 ID。
candidates.uses: Q1/Q2 分别按创建和签署日期筛选聚合；Q5 按关闭日期筛选后返回明细。
candidates.constraints: 不把 Q7 的 LEFT JOIN 诊断纳入此 INNER JOIN 候选；不与去 # 的键归一化 Join 混合。答案未通过。
candidates.evidence: 三条使用相同原始等值键 INNER JOIN，日期口径不同。

consumers.sql:
SELECT
  o.OwnerId,
  COUNT(*) AS n_opps,
  AVG(CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) - CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE)) AS avg_cycle_days
FROM Opportunity o
JOIN Contract c ON c.Id = o.ContractID__c
WHERE CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE) >= DATE '2023-04-01'
  AND CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE) < DATE '2023-05-01'
  AND c.CompanySignedDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.OwnerId
ORDER BY avg_cycle_days ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  o.OwnerId,
  COUNT(*) AS n_opps,
  AVG(CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) - CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE)) AS avg_cycle_days
FROM Opportunity o
JOIN Contract c ON c.Id = o.ContractID__c
WHERE CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) >= DATE '2023-04-01'
  AND CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) < DATE '2023-05-01'
GROUP BY o.OwnerId
ORDER BY avg_cycle_days ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  o.Id AS opp_id, o.OwnerId, o.CreatedDate, o.CloseDate, c.CompanySignedDate,
  CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) - CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE) AS cycle_days
FROM Opportunity o
JOIN Contract c ON c.Id = o.ContractID__c
WHERE CAST(o.CloseDate AS DATE) >= DATE '2023-04-01'
  AND CAST(o.CloseDate AS DATE) < DATE '2023-05-01'
ORDER BY o.OwnerId;

candidates.title: 去 # 的连接键与归一化 Join
candidates.prepare: 分别预计算 Contract.Id 和 Opportunity.ContractID__c 的 replace(...,'#','')；以归一键构建关联访问结构，并可准备归一键 INNER JOIN 行结果。
candidates.uses: Q7 的 c2 LEFT JOIN 分支使用预计算键/访问结构，保留外连接；Q8/Q9 可用归一键 INNER JOIN 明细。
candidates.constraints: Q7 只部分受益，不能用 INNER JOIN 改写整个 LEFT JOIN 诊断；归一化可能产生重复键，必须保留多重性。这是一个关联准备方案，不把键与 Join 另算两个机会。
candidates.evidence: 三条均在相同两表的相同键列使用相同 replace 去 # 连接表达式。

consumers.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS opp_with_contract,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c1.Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched_raw,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c2.Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched_stripped
FROM Opportunity o
LEFT JOIN Contract c1 ON c1.Id = o.ContractID__c
LEFT JOIN Contract c2 ON replace(c2.Id, '#', '') = replace(o.ContractID__c, '#', '')
WHERE o.ContractID__c IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  o.OwnerId,
  COUNT(*) AS n_opps,
  AVG(CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) - CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE)) AS avg_cycle_days,
  MIN(CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) - CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE)) AS min_cycle,
  MAX(CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) - CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE)) AS max_cycle
FROM Opportunity o
JOIN Contract c ON replace(c.Id, '#', '') = replace(o.ContractID__c, '#', '')
WHERE CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE) >= DATE '2023-04-01'
  AND CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE) < DATE '2023-05-01'
  AND c.CompanySignedDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.OwnerId
ORDER BY avg_cycle_days ASC;

SELECT
  o.OwnerId,
  COUNT(*) AS n_opps,
  AVG(CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) - CAST(o.CreatedDate AS DATE)) AS avg_cycle_days
FROM Opportunity o
JOIN Contract c ON replace(c.Id, '#', '') = replace(o.ContractID__c, '#', '')
WHERE CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) >= DATE '2023-04-01'
  AND CAST(c.CompanySignedDate AS DATE) < DATE '2023-05-01'
GROUP BY o.OwnerId
ORDER BY avg_cycle_days ASC;

candidates.title: 商机诊断的一次扫描统计准备
candidates.prepare: 对 Opportunity 无过滤完整输入，一次维护日期极值、总数、合同非空计数、月份和 # 前缀诊断计数。
candidates.uses: Q3 第一条语句、Q4 和 Q6 第一条语句使用其统计；Q3/Q6 的 Contract 语句仍独立执行。
candidates.constraints: Q3/Q6 是多语句调用，不能把合同统计与商机统计混合；末条结果才被适配器返回，因此前面的统计工作是否值得保留本身也存疑。弱候选。
candidates.evidence: 三次调用中的 Opportunity 统计分支均无 WHERE；Q3/Q4 有完全相同的 MIN/MAX、COUNT 和非空计数。

consumers.sql:
SELECT
  MIN(o.CreatedDate) AS min_created, MAX(o.CreatedDate) AS max_created,
  MIN(o.CloseDate) AS min_close, MAX(o.CloseDate) AS max_close,
  COUNT(*) AS n_opp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.ContractID__c IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_with_contract
FROM Opportunity o;

SELECT
  MIN(c.CompanySignedDate) AS min_signed, MAX(c.CompanySignedDate) AS max_signed,
  COUNT(*) AS n_contract
FROM Contract c;

SELECT
  MIN(CreatedDate) AS min_created, MAX(CreatedDate) AS max_created,
  MIN(CloseDate) AS min_close, MAX(CloseDate) AS max_close,
  COUNT(*) AS n_opp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ContractID__c IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_with_contract,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(CreatedDate AS DATE) >= DATE '2023-04-01' AND CAST(CreatedDate AS DATE) < DATE '2023-05-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_created_apr2023,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(CloseDate AS DATE) >= DATE '2023-04-01' AND CAST(CloseDate AS DATE) < DATE '2023-05-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_closed_apr2023
FROM Opportunity;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN ContractID__c LIKE '#%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hash_contract,
  SUM(CASE WHEN OwnerId LIKE '#%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hash_owner,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM Opportunity;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Id LIKE '#%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hash_id,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM Contract;

candidates.title: 多个销售时间窗口的共同明细
candidates.prepare: 准备日期 '2022-06-01' 至 '2022-11-30' 的订单及其 OrderItem 等值 Join，保留 OwnerId/Order.Id/EffectiveDate/Quantity/UnitPrice。
candidates.uses: Q3 保留滚动窗口筛选；Q4 三个 UNION ALL 分支分别筛选各自窗口后分组。
candidates.constraints: 只算两次跨调用使用，不将 Q4 三个分支算三条未来 SQL。Q3 的 LIMIT 10 聚合结果不能代替 Q4 全分组；共同明细可以。
candidates.evidence: 两次调用各分支 Join 键相同，三个日期窗口都包含于六月至十一月共同范围，滚动窗口分支还相同。

consumers.sql:
SELECT o.OwnerId AS agent_id,
       SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) AS total_sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS n_orders
FROM "Order" o
JOIN OrderItem oi ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
WHERE o.EffectiveDate >= '2022-06-25' AND o.EffectiveDate <= '2022-11-25'
GROUP BY o.OwnerId
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 'rolling_2022-06-25_to_2022-11-25' AS variant, o.OwnerId, SUM(oi.Quantity*oi.UnitPrice) AS total
FROM "Order" o JOIN OrderItem oi ON oi.OrderId=o.Id
WHERE o.EffectiveDate >= '2022-06-25' AND o.EffectiveDate <= '2022-11-25'
GROUP BY o.OwnerId
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cal_months_jun_to_nov', o.OwnerId, SUM(oi.Quantity*oi.UnitPrice)
FROM "Order" o JOIN OrderItem oi ON oi.OrderId=o.Id
WHERE o.EffectiveDate >= '2022-06-01' AND o.EffectiveDate <= '2022-11-30'
GROUP BY o.OwnerId
UNION ALL
SELECT 'last5_full_months_jun_to_oct', o.OwnerId, SUM(oi.Quantity*oi.UnitPrice)
FROM "Order" o JOIN OrderItem oi ON oi.OrderId=o.Id
WHERE o.EffectiveDate >= '2022-06-01' AND o.EffectiveDate <= '2022-10-31'
GROUP BY o.OwnerId
ORDER BY variant, total DESC;

candidates.title: 股票日期解析及共同分析输入
candidates.prepare: 对 index_trade 预计算两条 CTE 中完全相同的 COALESCE(try_strptime(...))::DATE，保留 Index/High/Low/Open/Close；可进一步准备相同六个指数且解析日期 >=2020-01-01 的行子集。
candidates.uses: Q8 从该输入计算 close 分母波动率及日期统计；Q9 计算 open/mid 等其他波动指标。
candidates.constraints: 只计 Q8/Q9；Q6 使用原始日期字符串比较，与解析日期过滤不等价，不能合并。保留 try_strptime 的 NULL 行为。
candidates.evidence: Q8/Q9 日期解析表达式、解析后日期下界和指数集合完全相同；仅额外投影及最终统计不同。

consumers.sql: WITH parsed AS (SELECT "Index", COALESCE(try_strptime("Date", '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), try_strptime("Date", '%B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p'), try_strptime("Date", '%d %b %Y, %H:%M'))::DATE AS d, "High", "Low", "Close" FROM index_trade) SELECT "Index", COUNT(*) AS n_days, MIN(d) AS first_date, MAX(d) AS last_date, AVG(("High" - "Low") / "Close") AS avg_intraday_vol FROM parsed WHERE d >= DATE '2020-01-01' AND "Index" IN ('000001.SS','399001.SZ','HSI','N225','NSEI','TWII') GROUP BY "Index" ORDER BY avg_intraday_vol DESC;

WITH parsed AS (SELECT "Index", COALESCE(try_strptime("Date", '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), try_strptime("Date", '%B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p'), try_strptime("Date", '%d %b %Y, %H:%M'))::DATE AS d, "High", "Low", "Open", "Close" FROM index_trade) SELECT "Index", AVG(("High" - "Low") / "Open") AS vol_open, AVG(("High" - "Low") / (("High" + "Low")/2)) AS vol_mid, AVG("High"/"Low" - 1) AS vol_hl_ratio FROM parsed WHERE d >= DATE '2020-01-01' AND "Index" IN ('000001.SS','399001.SZ','HSI','N225','NSEI','TWII') GROUP BY "Index" ORDER BY vol_open DESC;

candidates.title: 北美指数窗口输入
candidates.prepare: 按原 SQL 字符串比较语义，准备三个指数、Date >= '2017-11-01' 且 Date < '2019-01-01' 的原始行，保留 Index/Date/Open/Close；可在原排序语义下组织数据。
candidates.uses: Q6 再筛 2018 下界后比较 Open/Close；Q7 在宽窗口上先算 LAG，再筛 2018。
candidates.constraints: 不可先裁到 2018 再算 LAG，会丢前驱行；原 SQL 字符串日期比较的业务正确性存疑，任务未通过，本候选仅讨论保留实际 SQL 语义。相同日期键的排序不唯一性仍需重放核对。
candidates.evidence: 两条指数集合及上界相同；Q6 窗口包含于 Q7 LAG 前的宽窗口。

consumers.sql:
SELECT "Index",
       SUM(CASE WHEN "Close" > "Open" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up_days,
       SUM(CASE WHEN "Close" < "Open" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_days,
       SUM(CASE WHEN "Close" = "Open" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flat_days,
       COUNT(*) AS total_days
FROM index_trade
WHERE "Index" IN ('NYA','IXIC','GSPTSE')
  AND "Date" >= '2018-01-01' AND "Date" < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY "Index"
ORDER BY "Index";

WITH t AS (
  SELECT "Index", "Date", "Open", "Close",
         LAG("Close") OVER (PARTITION BY "Index" ORDER BY "Date") AS prev_close
  FROM index_trade
  WHERE "Index" IN ('NYA','IXIC','GSPTSE')
    AND "Date" >= '2017-11-01' AND "Date" < '2019-01-01'
)
SELECT "Index",
       MIN("Date") AS first_date, MAX("Date") AS last_date, COUNT(*) AS n,
       SUM(CASE WHEN "Close" > prev_close THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up_vs_prev,
       SUM(CASE WHEN "Close" < prev_close THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_vs_prev
FROM t
WHERE "Date" >= '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY "Index"
ORDER BY "Index";
